coveragePolicy: Populated means at least one validated game record exists for the platform; planned means the taxonomy is canonical but content expansion has not started; partial is reserved for a reviewed slice that is not yet complete. catalogTarget records the alpha or expansion sequencing target independently.

sources.label: Nintendo IR dedicated video game sales units

excludedByDefault.label: Virtual Boy
excludedByDefault.reason: Dedicated stereoscopic tabletop hardware does not fit the home-console or handheld-family scope; add only with an explicit all-hardware scope decision.

excludedByDefault.label: Peripheral and add-on hardware
excludedByDefault.reason: Disk systems, 64DD, Game Boy Player, Balance Board, and similar accessories are not independent platform families.

excludedByDefault.label: Classic Edition and mini reproductions
excludedByDefault.reason: Retro reproductions are model/products of an existing platform family, not new game platforms.
